eligibilityRule: Every documented runtime export in the explicitly selected published entrypoint is implemented over the same JavaScript input domain and with the same algorithmic work; upstream-derived assertions, dense differential vectors, and identical app contracts pass; every adapter byte is measured; the LilScript Vite 8 artifact is no larger than either npm Vite 8 or public-API-preserving Closure ADVANCED in raw bytes or the explicitly selected transport codec; and representative throughput and retained-memory workloads show no material regression. Alternate gzip-9 and Brotli-11 sizes are always reported because optimizing one codec is not a promise about another. Partial, adapter-algorithm, and subset implementations are implementation backlog only and are not published as library comparisons. C/native checks are additional portability evidence where the selected API can be represented natively, not a substitute for JavaScript compatibility.

Differential checks cover defaults and coercions, deterministic customRandom vectors, randomness/distribution, Uint8Array output, export keys, and the Number-valued 2147483648 callback step. The default export's exact {all,on,off,emit} object surface is preserved, including supplied Map identity, string and Symbol keys, first-only removal of duplicate handlers, snapshot behavior when listeners mutate registration during emit, omitted payload undefined, and direct-before-wildcard dispatch. The tiny measured JavaScript boundary only exposes the compiled function; all of its bytes are counted.

results.compatibilityNotes: Copy-on-write ImmValue draft tree lives in LilScript (no Proxies in-language). A measured JavaScript facade restores immer-like produce/current/original mutation syntax and enablePatches/produceWithPatches/applyPatches. Patch generation (assigned-key object patches + array length/index patches + replacement patches) runs in LilScript; applyPatches is restored in the facade over plain deep-cloned values (matching immer's JSON-patch ops for the contract). Covers nested object/array drafts, push/pop, property assign/delete, recipe return replacement, same-reference when unchanged, and patch round-trips. Blocked from complete: no Map/Set/Date/class/immerable drafts, no freeze/manual createDraft/finishDraft public API, and Proxy traps remain a JS-facade necessity because LilScript cannot express them.
